title: Closana Launches a New Era of Capital Advisory: Raising Smarter, Faster, and Without the Guesswork | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
"Blitz Model" by Closana reshapes startup fundraising with execution-first strategies and real investor connections.
Closana , a modern capital advisory platform, is setting a new standard for startup fundraising by offering execution-first support that delivers signed term sheets — not just advice. Designed for founders who prioritize results over rhetoric, Closana enables early-stage startups to raise $500K–$5M in capital with speed, precision, and real investor engagement.
With a focus on action rather than theory, Closana replaces the outdated, slow-moving models of traditional fundraising advisors. Instead of charging heavy retainers for vague introductions and unstructured strategies, Closana's Blitz Model leverages data-driven systems, success-fee alignment, and targeted investor engagement to get founders funded faster.
"Fundraising is broken for early-stage founders," said Aziz Hemissi, Founder and CEO of Closana. "Startups don't need more advice—they need warm investor conversations, real engagement, and signed term sheets. Closana was built to deliver exactly that."
A Proven System for Raising Capital — Smarter and Faster
Closana's proprietary three-step Capital Blitz system redefines the fundraising journey:
Investor Packaging : Within 14–21 days, Closana crafts world-class pitch decks, financial models, and one-pagers, establishing instant credibility and readiness for investor conversations.
Targeted Blitz Outreach : The Closana team executes personalized campaigns to 300–500+ relevant investors per client, securing rapid traction through high-quality, tech-powered outbound strategies.
Deal Conversion Support : From first reply to signed term sheet, Closana offers expert negotiation support, follow-up strategies, and closing tactics to maximize funding success.
Unlike traditional advisors who prioritize high retainer fees and passive advice, Closana operates without retainers or equity grabs. The company’s model is simple: an affordable upfront fee plus a success fee — ensuring Closana’s growth is directly tied to their clients' success.
Real Results, Not Empty Promises
In a market where traditional capital advisory models often fail to deliver tangible outcomes, Closana stands apart:
Over $1.2 billion in active fundraising rounds targeted
30–50 warm investor introductions generated per client
More than $300 million of investor interest engaged
500+ startups targeted monthly across venture capital, SaaS, fintech, healthtech, and deeptech sectors
"Closana is not a consulting firm," Hemissi emphasized. "We are your fundraising execution partner. We operate with urgency, precision, and a shared goal: helping founders secure the capital they need to build great companies."
Built for Founders Who Demand Speed and Results
Closana is ideal for early-stage startups serious about raising venture capital without the traditional pain points:
No Retainers. No Equity Grabs.
Real VC Access, Not Empty Networks.
Execution-Focused, Not Just Pretty Slides.
Faster, Smarter, Data-Driven Fundraising.
Through Closana, founders no longer need to endure six-month delays, random introductions, or endless PowerPoint reviews. Instead, they engage directly with investors, build meaningful conversations, and close rounds with confidence.
For more information, visit: Closana.ai
